scripts.build: npm run setup-models && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/content.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/src/content.js --target=es2022 --format=iife && esbuild src/background.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/src/background.js --target=es2022 --format=esm && esbuild src/popup.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/src/popup.js --target=es2022 --format=esm && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist/frontend', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.cpSync('../frontend', 'dist/frontend', {recursive: true});"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/**/*.test.js && node tests/verify_e2e.js
